units.source_text: 岳母去世以后，我尽量温柔地对待妻子。

en.t: After my mother-in-law died, I treated my wife as gently as I could.

units.source_text: 这不仅仅是出于对她的爱，在我的温情中，似乎还有着超越某个人的更为广阔的背景。

en.t: It was not only because I loved her; in my tenderness there seemed to be a broader background that went beyond any one person.

units.source_text: 同看护岳母时的心情一样，我的心有了活力，妻子看起来很满足。

en.t: As when I had cared for my mother-in-law, my heart became lively, and my wife seemed satisfied.

units.source_text: 但是，那满足之中似乎又隐含着因不能理解我而形成的淡淡阴影。

en.t: Yet within that satisfaction there seemed to lurk a faint shadow born from her inability to understand me.

units.source_text: 即便妻子理解了我，这种不满足的情绪也不会减少多少，

en.t: Even if my wife had understood me, this feeling of dissatisfaction would not have lessened very much,

units.source_text: 因为，我认为比起来自伟大的人道立场上的爱来，

en.t: because I believed that, compared with love that comes from a great humanitarian standpoint,

units.source_text: 即便稍稍不合情理，女人也喜欢只专注于自己的温柔之情，这种天性

en.t: the nature by which a woman is pleased by tenderness directed only toward herself, even if it is somewhat unreasonable,

units.source_text: 女人比男人似乎更强一些。

en.t: seems to be stronger in women than in men.

units.source_text: 一次，妻子说，男人的心和女人的心难道就不能紧紧贴在一起吗？

en.t: Once my wife asked whether a man's heart and a woman's heart really could not cling closely together.

units.source_text: 我模棱两可地答道，只有年轻的时候才可能吧。

en.t: I answered evasively that perhaps it was possible only when people were young.

units.source_text: 妻子像是在回想自己年轻的时候，然后发出了一声轻轻的叹息。

en.t: My wife seemed to be recalling her own youth, and then she gave a soft sigh.

units.source_text: 从那时起，我心中常常闪过一个可怕的影子，起初是偶然从外面袭来的。

en.t: From that time on, a terrible shadow often flashed through my heart; at first it attacked me by chance from outside.

units.source_text: 可是不多久，我的心仿佛与那可怕的影子呼应起来。

en.t: But before long my heart seemed to answer that terrible shadow.

units.source_text: 后来，即使没有来自外界，我也觉得它从自己一出生，就潜伏在自己内心深处了。

en.t: Later, even when it did not come from outside, I felt it had been lurking deep within me from the moment I was born.

units.source_text: 每逢这样感觉时，我就怀疑自己的大脑是不是出了什么毛病。

en.t: Whenever I felt this way, I suspected that something might be wrong with my mind.

units.source_text: 但是，我并不想请医生或其他什么人来给我诊断。

en.t: But I had no desire to have a doctor or anyone else examine me.
